Class QJournalProtocolServerSideTranslatorPB

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.qjournal.protocolPB.QJournalProtocolServerSideTranslatorPB
All Implemented Interfaces:
QJournalProtocolProtos.QJournalProtocolService.BlockingInterface, QJournalProtocolPB
@Private public class QJournalProtocolServerSideTranslatorPB extends Object implements QJournalProtocolPB
Implementation for protobuf service that forwards requests received on JournalProtocolPB to the JournalProtocol server implementation.
